title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 21 in B-flat major

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1. Bass: the opening of the subject, inverted (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 2, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 45–47).

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar.

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in E♭ major (Soprano); Answer in B♭ major (Alto)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 17–21) in part, with the soprano's line in the alto, the alto's line in the bass, the bass's line in the soprano, transposed. Soprano: a figure from countersubject 2. Alto: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 and a figure from the subject, inverted.
